_comment: Finding code -> default disposition. A line's disposition is the most severe disposition among its unresolved findings (escalate > dispute > accept). 'monetary' findings carry an amount that explains part of the line's delta.

UNMATCHED_REF.summary: reference matches no booking for this carrier

CARRIER_MISMATCH.summary: reference belongs to another carrier's booking

NOT_DELIVERED.summary: shipment is not recorded as delivered

CONTRACT_GAP.summary: the contract does not price this case

SERVICE_NOT_OFFERED.summary: service level not offered under the contract

ARITHMETIC_ERROR.summary: line total disagrees with its own components

UNAUTHORISED_ACCESSORIAL.summary: charge not payable under the contract

ACCESSORIAL_NOT_APPLICABLE.summary: contract charge billed where its condition does not apply

RATE_MISMATCH.summary: billed amount differs from the contract amount

DUPLICATE_BILLING.summary: consignment already billed on another invoice

DUPLICATE_MISMATCH.summary: consignment billed again with different details

CREDIT_APPLIED.summary: credit note corrects an overbill on the original line

PARTIAL_CREDIT.summary: credit note does not cover the full overbill

CREDIT_EXCEEDS.summary: credit exceeds the overbill it corrects

CREDIT_WITHOUT_OVERBILL.summary: credit against a line that was not overbilled

CREDIT_UNREFERENCED.summary: credit note references an unknown invoice or line

CREDIT_ON_UNDETERMINED.summary: credit against a line whose contract amount is undetermined

OUT_OF_PERIOD.summary: shipped outside the invoice's billing period

RECORD_MISMATCH.summary: printed attributes differ from the shipment record

MISSING_DISCOUNT.summary: volume discount due but not applied in full

DISCOUNT_UNDETERMINED.summary: discount shortfall depends on undetermined lines

DISCOUNT_PERIOD_AMBIGUOUS.summary: cannot tell which invoice carries the month's discount
